verification.note: This receipt is necessarily self-referential (it names the commit that contains it), which is a genuine hash-preimage impossibility to close exactly by iteration: each amend that updates this field changes the receipt's own bytes, which changes the tree hash, which changes the commit hash again. This value was corrected once by amend to the best currently-known HEAD; no further amend was attempted after this edit, so this field may describe the commit immediately prior to the one actually holding this exact byte content, by exactly one step. For this reason dispatch_queue.json's TASK-20260815-0f5486 entry uses archive.binding_mode: content_first (verifies declared path_sha256 against the tree at HEAD rather than requiring one exact single-commit diff match) as the authoritative, dispatcher-checked binding; this field is retained for human readability only and is not itself re-validated by tools/research_dispatch.py.
